description: Core defaults for the BAUD main window - the app's own command invokes and channels, the webview zoom setter for the header's zoom control, and URL-opening in the default browser for ctrl+clicked terminal links (deliberately NOT the opener's reveal-in-dir or open-path). No shell plugin, no filesystem plugin, no asset protocol. Every file-reading command is fenced to the AIPass root and read-only; the pty commands drive the operator's own terminal.
